changes.summary: Custom ResolveToDataSource reference handling during export now applies only when the target data source type is listed in replace_with_datasource, except for resolvers that always emit data source references regardless of that list.

After exclude_attributes are applied, users that share a DID with an IVR receive a dependency on that IVR so generated configuration tends to create the IVR first; excluded DNIS or address fields are not used for matching.

related_export_changes.summary: Users sharing a DID with an IVR may export with an explicit dependency on that IVR for apply ordering.
IVRs that share a DID with exported users may be referenced as dependency targets in generated user configuration.
Topic GUID references export as data source blocks only when genesyscloud_speechandtextanalytics_topic is in replace_with_datasource; otherwise values remain raw topic IDs.
Attributes using custom data-source resolvers may omit generated data blocks when the data source type is not listed in replace_with_datasource, unless the resolver always resolves to a data source.
